subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw make `deferred` a public cron/run status and expose yielded-parent lifecycle classification through the reply runtime SDK for this fix?
rationale: The patch is not just an internal bug fix; it expands persisted status values, Gateway protocol, CLI/UI/docs, hooks, and plugin-facing SDK exports, which needs explicit product/API ownership.

options.title: Accept Deferred Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve the public status and SDK shape, then require Discord-visible and upgrade compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Internal Lifecycle Fix
options.body: Ask the contributor to avoid new public status/SDK surface and keep the fix internal to cron, Discord, and subagent runtime paths.

options.title: Pause For Related PR Consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers decide how it should compose with the other yielded-parent wake and diagnostic PRs.

recommendation.title: Accept Deferred Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the public status and SDK shape, then require Discord-visible and upgrade compatibility proof before merge.
